acquired_by.description: Relates an artist to an organisation that purchased some of their work.

affiliated_with.description: Relates a person (occasionally an organisation) to an organisation, institution or group they were associated with.

applied_to.description: Relates a person to an organisation they applied to for funding.

approached.description: Relates a person to an organisation they approached with a proposal.

artist_in_residence.description: Marks an artist or artist group that has held an artist residency.

assistant_to.description: Relates a person to the person they worked for as an assistant.

became_cameraman.description: Marks a person who became a professional cameraman.

born_in.description: Relates a person to their place of birth, given as text.

broadcast_by.description: Relates a work to the broadcaster, station or channel that transmitted it.

co_edited_by.description: Relates a publication to two people who co-edited it.

collaborated_with.description: Relates an artist (occasionally an organisation, or a jointly made work) to a person or organisation they collaborated with; most pairs are stored in one direction only.

commissioned_by.description: Relates a work (occasionally an artist) to the organisation, venue or person that commissioned it.

commissioning_editor_for.description: Relates a person to the broadcaster for which they were a commissioning editor.

conserved_by.description: Relates a work to the organisation responsible for conserving it.

conserved_in_project.description: Relates a work to a conservation project that included it.

contains_photograph_of.description: Relates a work to a free-text description of a subject photographed in it.

country_represented.description: Relates a work to the country, given as text, that it represented at an international exhibition.

created_by.description: Relates a work to the artist or artist group who made it.

curated_by.description: Relates an exhibition, programme, compilation or work to the person who curated or selected it.

department_name.description: Records the name, given as text, of a department within an institution.

depicts.description: Relates a work to a place or object shown or used in it.

distributed_by.description: Relates a work, or an artist's body of work, to the organisation that distributed it.

document.description: Marks a source interview transcript from which facts in this dataset were extracted.

documented_by.description: Relates a work to a person who made a video documentation of it.

duration_minutes.description: Records the running time of a work in minutes.

edited_at.description: Relates an artist, or a work, to the studio, institution or facility where editing was done.

edited_by.description: Relates a work or publication to the person who edited it.

educated_at.description: Relates a person to an institution where they studied.

employed_by.description: Relates a person to an organisation or institution they worked for, including teaching posts.

established_programme.description: Relates a person to the name, given as text, of an academic programme they set up.

event.description: Marks an entity as an event, such as a festival or tour.

exhibited_at.description: Relates a work, or an artist or group, to a venue, exhibition or place where the work was shown.

exhibition.description: Marks an entity as an exhibition, show, festival or broadcast programme.

exhibition_title.description: Records the title of an exhibition or exhibition series as text.

external_examiner_at.description: Relates a person to an institution where they served as an external examiner.

featured_person.description: Relates a work to a free-text description of a person or figure who appears in it.

filmed_at.description: Relates a work to a location where its footage was filmed.

financed_by.description: Records, as free text, how an artist financed their practice.

first_shown_at.description: Relates a work to the venue where it was first shown.

founded_by.description: Relates an organisation, course or other initiative to a person who founded, co-founded or established it.

funded_by.description: Relates a person, work, organisation or event to an organisation that funded it.

got_funding_for.description: Relates a person to a kind of activity, given as text, for which they received funding.

had_machine_made_by.description: Relates a work to the person who built a machine used in it.

held_at.description: Relates an exhibition or event to the venue or institution where it was held.

idea_for.description: Relates a work to a later work for which it provided the idea.

in_collection.description: Relates a work to the museum or institution whose collection holds it.

influenced_by.description: Relates an artist to a person, such as an artist or writer, who influenced or inspired their work.

installed_at.description: Relates an installation work to the place or venue where it was installed or set up.

interviewed.description: Relates a person to someone they interviewed, as mentioned in an interview; the source interviews themselves are recorded by interviewee.

interviewed_artist.description: Marks an artist who is the subject of one of the source interviews in this dataset.

interviewee.description: Relates a source interview transcript to the artist interviewed in it.

invited_to.description: Relates a person to an institution, exhibition or event they were invited to visit or take part in.

involved_in.description: Relates a person to an organisation, project, programme, exhibition or activity they took part in.

job_title.description: Relates a person to a job or position, given as text, that they held.

led.description: Relates a person to an organisation, institution or department they led as director, head, chair or president.

located_in.description: Relates a venue or organisation to the area, city or country where it is.

made_at.description: Relates a work to the venue, institution or place where it was made, including one whose facilities were used.

member_of.description: Relates a person to an organisation, union or artistic group they belonged to, including as a founding or council member.

mentor_of.description: Relates a mentor to the person they mentored.

met_at.description: Relates a person to a venue where they met someone; the other person is not recorded.

mission_statement_created_for.description: Relates an organisation to a person who took part in writing its mission statement.

moved_to.description: Relates a person to a place they moved to.

music_promotion_by.description: Relates a musician or band to a person who promoted their live performances.

named_by_competition.description: Marks a work whose name was chosen through a public competition.

organisation.description: Marks an entity as an organisation, such as an institution, funder, broadcaster, company, publication or artist group.

organised_by.description: Relates an exhibition, event or programme to the person or organisation that organised it.

partner_of.description: Relates a person to their life partner.

performed_at.description: Relates an artist or performance group (occasionally a performance work) to a venue or event where they performed.

performed_in.description: Relates a person to a work in which they performed or appeared.

person.description: Marks an entity as an individual person.

photographed_by.description: Relates a work to the person who took photographs used in it.

place.description: Marks an entity as a geographic place, such as a city, area or country.

produced_by.description: Relates a work to a person who produced it.

programmed.description: Relates a person to the kind of material, given as text, that they selected for a screening programme.

project_for.description: Relates an artist to an organisation for which they made a commissioned project.

promoted_medium.description: Relates an organisation to an artistic medium, given as text, that it actively promoted.

protagonist_in.description: Relates a person to the artist in whose work they appeared as a protagonist.

published_by.description: Relates a publication or published piece to the organisation or editor responsible for publishing it.

published_catalogues_of.description: Relates a venue or publisher to an artist or group whose work it published catalogues of.

published_in.description: Relates a work, article or special issue to the periodical in which it was published or written about.

ran.description: Relates a person to something, given as text, that they ran or managed.

renamed_as.description: Relates an organisation to the name or organisation it was later renamed as.

residency_at.description: Relates an artist to a place or venue where they held a residency.

reviewed_by.description: Relates a work, or an artist, to a critic or writer who reviewed or wrote about it.

reviewed_in.description: Relates a work, or an artist, to a publication in which it was reviewed or discussed.

sold_at.description: Relates a work to a retailer that sold copies of it.

sold_work_to.description: Relates an artist to a buyer, given as text, to whom they sold work.

soundtrack_by.description: Relates a work to a person or group who made its music or soundtrack.

source_url.description: Relates a source interview transcript to the URL of the published document it was extracted from.

supported_by.description: Relates an artist to a person who supported or championed their career.

taught_at.description: Relates a person to an institution where they taught.

taught_by.description: Relates a student to a person who taught them.

travelled_to.description: Relates an artist or group to a place, given as text, that they travelled to.

used_equipment.description: Relates a work, or a person, to equipment, technology or software used in making it.

used_facilities_of.description: Relates a person to an institution, lab or company whose facilities or equipment they used.

used_premises.description: Relates an organisation to premises or a venue it used or rented, for example for meetings.

uses_actors.description: Marks a work made with actors.

uses_medium.description: Relates a work, or an artist's practice, to a medium, material, format or technique it uses.

uses_nonactors.description: Marks a work made with non-professional performers rather than actors.

venue.description: Marks an entity as a venue or location where work was made, shown or performed, such as a gallery, college, studio or site.

work.description: Marks an entity as a creative work, such as a video, film, installation, performance, broadcast or publication.

worked_as_assistant_in_city.description: Relates a person to a city, given as text, where they worked as an assistant.

worked_with_sound.description: Marks an artist who has worked with sound.

wrote_for.description: Relates a writer to a publication, such as a periodical or catalogue, they wrote for.

year_began.description: Records the year in which an organisation, project or work began.

year_broadcast.description: Records the year in which a work was broadcast.

year_created.description: Records the year in which a work was created. For the year an organisation, exhibition or event began, see year_began.

year_exhibited.description: Records a year in which an artist exhibited work.

year_involved.description: Records, as free text, the period in which a person was involved with an organisation.

year_joined.description: Records the year in which a person joined an organisation or post; the organisation is not recorded.

year_left.description: Records the year in which a person left an organisation or post; the organisation is not recorded.

year_moved.description: Records the year in which a person moved to a new place.

year_started_work.description: Records the year in which a person started working at an organisation.

year_travelled.description: Records a year in which an artist or group travelled; the destination is not recorded.
